messages.subject: cel files in multiple directories
parts:
Hi

Is it possible to have the CEL files located in different directories?
(just to keep the files more organized.)


For example, can I put the files into "myTest,A" and "myTest,B"
separately

rawData/myTest,A/GenomeWideSNP_6
rawData/myTest,B/GenomeWideSNP_6


and then create an AffymetrixCelSet that contains all the files in
both directories?


p.s. i thought this command would work but it doesn't:
cs <- AffymetrixCelSet$fromName("myTest", tags=c('A','B'), cdf=cdf)



Thanks
Jason

> Hi

> Is it possible to have the CEL files located in different directories?
> (just to keep the files more organized.)
>
>
> For example, can I put the files into "myTest,A" and "myTest,B"
> separately
>
> rawData/myTest,A/GenomeWideSNP_6
> rawData/myTest,B/GenomeWideSNP_6
>
>
> and then create an AffymetrixCelSet that contains all the files in
> both directories?
>
>
> p.s. i thought this command would work but it doesn't:
> cs <- AffymetrixCelSet$fromName("myTest", tags=c('A','B'), cdf=cdf)

Setup the two CEL sets and then "merge" them by append the 2nd to the 1st, e.g.

cs <- AffymetrixCelSet$fromName("myTest", tags="A", cdf=cdf);
cs2 <- AffymetrixCelSet$fromName("myTest", tags="B", cdf=cdf);
append(cs, cs2);

The full name of the merged CEL set will be the same as the 1st CEL set.

/Henrik
